attributes.name: Elizabeth B Amato
attributes.blurb: EVP & Chief Human Resources Officer, United Technologies Corporation
attributes.summary: Amato is in her current position since 2015. She joined UTC in 1985, and has held the most senior human resources executive leadership position at several business units including UTC Climate, Controls & Security, Carrier, Pratt & Whitney and Sikorsky. She is a recipient of the YWCA Women Achievers Award.
